findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. When Close skips its test command for a documentation-only change, `test_run` returns before running any tests and produces no results header. This branch then labels an existing named pytest test `not checked` at this line, although Close knows it did not run the test. The Done-when requirement says a named test Close did not run must show as `not run`. The new no-results test covers an opaque runner, not a run Close deliberately skipped.
findings.title: Not done: A deliberately skipped close run marks named tests not checked

stop.reason: Coordinator (Harm 2, reversible): one last round on the two cases workers hit every day — names wrapped in Markdown code marks match like plain names, and each test counts once with a failed teardown counted as that test's failure. Anything further in review.py is accepted as a follow-up.

why: Workers write proof lists by hand, and about one review round in five is a gate on a missing or wrong test name in that list
